Passages:
[1] [GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing Coverage > Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage > How to Enroll]
1. Choose coverage level (individual or family)
   - [How to add dependents for Family Coverage](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Bi_z-apVPHNL59e1tpHqEW7d7thRAQJ7/view?usp=sharing)
2. Email decision to total-rewards@gitlab.com
3. Complete ManuLife registration when invitation arrives
    - [Registration Guide](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_lZq0RO6CtDHjnUA9OMGGIRNZJcqfhUL/view?usp=sharing)
4. Access benefits at [portal.manulife.ca](https://id.manulife.ca/?ui_locales=en-CA)

[2] [GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing Coverage > Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage]
Comprehensive health coverage through ManuLife with no cost to you. GitLab covers 100% of premiums for team members, spouses, dependents, and domestic partners.

- All GitLab Canada Corp team members
- Coverage effective from hire date
- Spouses, dependents, and domestic partners eligible

[3] [GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing Coverage > Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage > Questions?]
- **ManuLife**: 1-800-268-6195 (8 AM - 8 PM EST, Mon-Fri)
- **Coverage Changes**: total-rewards@gitlab.com
- **Technical Support**: [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request)

---

Build your financial future with GitLab's Group RRSP through Canada Life. Employer matching up to 3% of base salary (maximum $2,500 CAD annually).

[4] [GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Important Documents & Legal Notices > COBRA Continuation Coverage]
If you leave GitLab, you may be eligible to continue medical, dental, and vision coverage through [COBRA](https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ebsa/about-ebsa/our-activities/resource-center/faqs/cobra-continuation-coverage.pdf) for up to 18 months.

COBRA Timeline Process

1. Termination updated in Workday → PlanSource by next business day
2. Information sent to [WEX (Discovery Benefits)](https://cobra.discoverybenefits.com/) (our COBRA administrator) every Wednesday
3. WEX has 14 days to generate and mail enrollment packet
4. You have 60 days from receipt to enroll (coverage retroactive)
5. 45 days from enrollment to bring payments current

**Current Employees:** Contact [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request) for general COBRA questions

**Former Employees:** Contact WEX (Discovery) Benefits at 866-451-3399 for specific administration questions

[5] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Private Dental Insurance]
From 1 November 2026, GitLab offers dental cover through Vhi (Vhi Dental Corporate 1) for team members and their dependents. GitLab covers 100% of the premium. You do not need to be enrolled in the Vhi medical plan to join the dental plan.

Coverage & Key Features

- See the [Dental Benefits at Glance](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/14_dvRGqy6zqnUwzh-tGQpdVqmEvOjkwl/edit?slide=id.p2#slide=id.p2) for Key Features of coverage
- See the [Vhi Dental Corporate 1 Table of Benefits](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zmICqGp8nFlaF0qWemOpH9FNdmMLGLt4/view?usp=sharing) for full policy details
- You do not have to enroll in the Medical Plan to enroll in the dental plan. 

How to Enroll

Dental is an optional add-on to the Vhi scheme. Register through the same online enrolment link you use for Vhi health insurance: 

1. Visit the [VHI online portal](https://www.vhi.ie/groups/?token=1EFD9A4A7D274CF193FDD729F3AFC145) or call VHI
2. Enter your GitLab Employee ID as "Employee Number"  
3. Enter your GitLab Department (from Workday) as "Cost Centre"
4. Choose "Dental Corporate 1" or call 056 777 5800 to discuss your needs

- If you are enrolling in both the medical and dental plans for the first time, submit the enrolment form twice (once per plan) using the same link

Premiums and Taxability (Benefit in Kind)

[6] [GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing Coverage > Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage > Key Features]
- Complete medical, dental, and vision coverage at no cost
- Separate plans for Quebec ([Plan B- English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QwJSkcQ6XoBrXz6llCxd_g_yOSNWZZJF/view?usp=sharing) & [Plan B- French](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1t9o7_PrQLNyWdZ4Wvq-H0SviVfQfPJqC/view?usp=sharing)) and other provinces ([Plan A- English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1l6qjUZLU3qIKhs5XkJXDe24JjQsNp247/view?usp=sharing) & [Plan A- French](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gyDNDftIMfXK2Tg7s_juhYb_lI_MgCdH/view?usp=sharing))
- WorldCare Medical Second Opinion service
- Personalized Prescribing genetic testing reimbursement
- 24/7 TELUS Health Virtual Care in English and French
- Earn Aeroplan Points

Question: What is the second step a GitLab Canada Corp employee must take to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage?

Answer:
The second step is to email your decision to total-rewards@gitlab.com [1].
